name: pond_grotto

interaction.note: stand on the near (south) bank, in front of the water edge, facing north

note: both 96x64 on one canvas/scale/palette, bottom-aligned: swap the image in place. collision = left rock, right rock, arch above the mouth, and the pond (rect 4): the water in front is ~29 px deep (0.9 tiles), not a thin edge, so it is non-walkable in both states. mouth_rect is an extra blocker while dark; once lit drop it (it can be the pickup / scene trigger), but the pond still separates the bank from the mouth, so the fragment at fragment_point is collected from the interaction point (or the glowmoth fetches it); remove rect 4 if the player should wade in.
